schema_version = "1.4"
# Only the ledger reaches the separate verifier; nothing else the agent
# leaves behind (processes, reward files, PATH shims) survives into grading.
artifacts = ["/app/data/ledger.db"]

[task]
name = "petermakhnatch/transaction-reconciliation"
version = "0.2.0"
description = "Repair one inconsistent transaction in a seeded SQLite ledger."
authors = []
keywords = ["harbor", "sqlite", "reconciliation", "database", "separate-verifier"]

[metadata]
difficulty = "easy"
category = "programming"
tags = ["local", "deterministic"]

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 120.0
environment_mode = "separate"
collect = []

[verifier.env]

[agent]
timeout_sec = 120.0

[environment]
network_mode = "public"
build_timeout_sec = 600.0
os = "linux"
mcp_servers = []

[environment.env]

[solution.env]

FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm

COPY . /tests

RUN mkdir -p /app/data /logs/verifier \
    && chmod +x /tests/test.sh

WORKDIR /app

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

# Grading runs in the separate verifier image built from tests/Dockerfile.
# Nothing is installed or fetched here, and the interpreter is called by
# absolute path so nothing on PATH can stand in for it.
exec /usr/local/bin/python3 /tests/verify.py

rationale: Cheat ladder cracked the shipped task on Harbor 0.24 (tamper_reward_writer: background loop holds /logs/verifier/reward.* at 1 in the shared container). Grade in a separate verifier image built from tests/Dockerfile that receives only /app/data/ledger.db; stdlib verifier, no grade-time installs, absolute interpreter path.
